flags.note: Points at text that clearly warrants reviewer attention, though under-coded. 'Would have supported a 6.5% annual withdrawal ... without ever running out of money' applied to every 30-year period 1970-2025 is model/backtested performance: the draft gives no criteria, no assumptions (return series, allocation, fee/tax drag, inflation basis, overlapping vs. discrete windows), and no risks or limitations, so C5 is the dominant defect. The flagged phrase itself is also an unsupported absolute under C6, and the chosen 1970 start raises C4. The boilerplate 'past performance does not guarantee future results' does not cure any of these. Not one of the known issues (none unmatched).
